topic: What If Asta Was Reborn With All His Memories and Anti-Magic? | Part 1
executiveSummary: Canon baseline for a Black Clover rebirth what-if. Asta is born without mana and is left at the Hage church; Anti-Magic is not innate but belongs to the devil Liebe, sealed by Licita inside a five-leaf grimoire that surfaces from the Hage grimoire tower when Asta is fifteen. Ki is learned from Yami, Zetten in the Land of the Sun. The captains Vangeance (sharing a body with Patolli) and Gueldre, the devil Zagred, and the Julius/Lucius shared body are the hidden-information levers a reborn Asta would hold.

claims.statement: Asta and Yuno were both left as babies at the church in Hage village and raised there by Father Orsi and Sister Lily. Asta's listed birthday is October 4 (the day he was found). The search tool found no source giving Yuno a birthday, so 'both abandoned the same day' and 'Yuno's birthday is Oct 4' are not source-supported.
claims.notes: Surnames 'Orfai' and 'Aquaria' were NOT seen in any result; treat as unverified. The 'Sister Lily travelled to the Forsaken Realm' backstory appears in a search summary only.

claims.statement: A huge demon skull sits on the outskirts of Hage with a statue of the first Wizard King on top. The statue is later revealed to be the king himself (Lemiel), sealed in stone by his servant Secre Swallowtail; magic stones embedded in it revive him with Finral's help. The skull being Licht's transformed body is NOT supported by what was found.
claims.notes: Name conflict: TV Tropes writes 'Lumiere Silvamillion Clover'; Anibase/Bubbleblabber write 'Lemiel'. The 'Licht transformed into the skull' premise was not found in results; the search summary only said sources 'treat Licht as demon-transformed figure tied to the battle', which is vague. Mark the Licht/skull link unverified. Anime episode 117 'Breaking the Seal' (tvmaze title) appears connected to the statue/seal reveal.

claims.statement: Licita is Asta's biological mother; her body involuntarily absorbed mana and life force from living things nearby, so she left Asta at the Hage church to keep him alive. The reveal is placed around chapters 267-270 (sources disagree: 267 for Liebe's identity, 268, 270 for Licita being the mother) and a third source says chapter 328.
claims.temporalAnchor: Ch. ~267-270 (sources disagree); ch. 326-328 shows more of her past
claims.notes: Asta born without mana is tied to this in sources, but the exact causal wording differs between fan sites. Fandom wiki spells her 'Richita' (https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Richita seen in results). Verify chapter against Viz before using a number on screen.

claims.statement: Liebe is a devil who is Anti-Magic's source in Asta's grimoire. Licita took him in as foster child and sealed him in the five-leaf grimoire to protect him from Lucifero, who killed her. Liebe's identity is first revealed around ch. 267. 'Low-ranking, no magic, slipped to the human world, persecuted' and 'hatred of devils became Anti-Magic' were NOT confirmed by the results.
claims.notes: Chapter 326 raws article titled 'Asta discovers Liebe's past' and 328 'Licita's past' appear in result titles (sportskeeda), suggesting the detailed backstory is ch. 326-328. The 'Lucifero tried to take Liebe's body' detail was not seen. Mark unverified.

claims.statement: The five-leaf grimoire was Licht's four-leaf grimoire that became five-leaf through his despair when his clan was killed (corrupted by Zagred's machinations per one source). Demon-Slayer (Asta's first sword, from the grimoire), Demon-Dweller (acquired during the Dungeon arc fighting Mars) and Demon-Destroyer (obtained from Licht/exchanged around anime ep. 100-101) are tied to Licht. Asta's later fourth sword is Yami's Demon-Slasher (ch. 316).
claims.temporalAnchor: Dweller: Dungeon arc (anime ep. 'Dungeon'); Destroyer: anime ep. 100-101; Slasher: ch. 316
claims.notes: No manga chapter number found for Dweller or Destroyer acquisition. Sources disagree on Destroyer (taken from Licht vs found at Midnight Sun hideout). One source says the Destroyer was 'left inside Asta's grimoire as a trade for the Dweller' (ANN ep. 101 review) - ambiguous. Do not state 'originally Licht's swords' for all three without checking the Fandom pages.

claims.statement: The ceremony is for 15-year-olds, held at a Grimoire Tower; Yuno gets a four-leaf grimoire, Asta nothing. Revchi Salik (ex-Magic Knight turned thief, chain magic) ambushes Yuno to steal the grimoire. The five-leaf grimoire arrives during the fight after Yuno calls Asta his rival; the Fandom ceremony page describes it flying out of the wall of the tower.
claims.notes: Month: Fandom-wiki snippet says the ceremony is held each March (via search summary, treat as moderately reliable). Which squad Revchi was expelled from: NOT FOUND - unverified. A search for 'Silver Eagles' returned nothing. 'Hage' location of this tower is not explicitly confirmed in snippets (ceremony 'for 15-year-olds from Hage and surrounding area'). Tower master tells Asta to try again next year (per snippet).

claims.statement: A drunkard mocks Yuno's weak wind magic and takes his pendant/necklace; young Asta tackles the man, is knocked aside, keeps getting up until the man gives up and drops it; the boys then reaffirm their vow to become Wizard King. It is in chapter 1 (flashback pages ~38-54), anime ep. 2, not chapter 2.
claims.notes: 'Crybaby Yuno resolved to become Wizard King at this moment' is not in the snippet; 'crybaby' not confirmed. Check page wording before using.

claims.statement: Yami teaches Asta Ki (the 'qi/gi' sensing technique) while they fight Licht in the cave; Ki comes from Yami's homeland Hino Country (Land of the Sun). Asta 'masters Ki' in chapter 339 (per Sportskeeda title).
claims.temporalAnchor: Cave fight with Licht: Light Magic vs Dark Magic (early arc, chapter list title); Ki mastery: ch. 339
claims.notes: The premise 'Licht/Patolli in the Gauche's sister arc' is WRONG/mixed: Licht (in cave with Yami) appears in the Dungeon/Licht arc (Light Magic vs Dark Magic). Gauche's sister arc is a different story thread (Gauche and Marie). Patolli and Licht are different identities in the same body, but they are not the 'Gauche's sister arc' opponent. Chapter/episode number for the cave scene was not found (title only). Anime ep. 'Light Magic vs. Dark Magic' is the Bubble Blabber title.

claims.statement: Asta learns Zetten in the Land of the Sun (Hino Country) - an Anti-Magic-augmented use of the Ki 'Yoryoku' principle, guided by Ryuya, who suggested practising against Ichika Yami. Chapter 337 = Asta arrives in Hino; 339 = Ki mastery; 340 = Zetten practice with Ichika; 343 = 'perfect Zetten' tease; 366 = Zetten power cliffhanger (comicbook title).
claims.notes: One summary says Ryuya taught him to 'substitute Yoryoku with Anti-Magic'. Whether Ichika, Ryuya or both 'taught' Zetten is unclear in snippets. Treat 'who taught him' as Ryuya (+ Ichika as sparring partner), pending Viz check.

claims.statement: Six months after the ceremony Asta and Yuno attend the Magic Knights Entrance Exam. Asta beats Sekke Bronzazza; Yuno is chosen by all nine captains and picks the Golden Dawn; Yami (Black Bulls) is the only captain to accept Asta. 'Raising a hand' is not confirmed in snippets (the exam uses selection by captains, wording may differ).
claims.notes: One snippet says none of the captains took interest in Asta, and Yami argued it was because of Asta's irregular magic - this matches the 'only Yami' beat. 'Raise a hand' phrasing is unverified.

claims.statement: Nero is the anti-bird form of Secre Swallowtail, servant of first Wizard King Lemiel/Lumiere Silvamillion Clover, a sealing-magic user, who waited hundreds of years to free him. She has been with Asta since early in the story. The '~500 years' figure appears only in secondary guides.
claims.temporalAnchor: Anime ep. 117 'Breaking the Seal' (reveal); Nero introduced early
claims.notes: 'Followed Asta since the entrance exam' is not literally in snippets (they say 'at the start of the series').

claims.statement: William Vangeance (World Tree magic) shares his body with elf Patolli, leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun; Patolli, acting through Vangeance, defeats Julius in the Royal Knights arc. The 'Julius dies, later returns in a 13-year-old body' premise is only partly supported: Julius appears as a 13-year-old boy in canon after the Patolli fight (sources say time magic / 'saved 13 years on the cross on his forehead'), then 'regains adult form' later (EpicDope on ch. 281). A ComicBook title references 'wizard king Julius death/alive/revival' at ch. 214.
claims.temporalAnchor: Royal Knights arc (anime ep. ~93-98); ch. 214 (Julius), ch. 281 (adult form)
claims.notes: Do NOT script 'Julius dies and is reborn'; sources show he survives via Time Magic with cost, and Lucius/Julius two-souls twist comes later. One source says the young body is Lucius's. Contradictions across sources.

claims.statement: Gueldre Poizot (Purple Orcas captain) is exposed as the traitor via memory magic used on captured Midnight Sun members (Marx's Memory Magic) - ANN/Bubble Blabber ep. 38-39 area. Fuegoleon Vermillion lost an arm in the royal capital raid, though sources differ on who caused it (trap / Valtos / Patry).
claims.temporalAnchor: Anime ep. 38-39 (Three-Leaf Salute); Fuegoleon arm: royal capital arc
claims.notes: Both Gueldre exposure (Marx-memory) and Fuegoleon's arm are in the Royal Capital arc per summaries, but the cause of Fuegoleon's injury is disputed by sources. Fuegoleon later forms a fire arm (Salamander). Chapter numbers not found.

claims.statement: The devil Zagred orchestrated the fall of the elves 500 years ago (framing the first Wizard King's family/royals as attackers) and manipulated Patolli, revealing the truth to him in the Shadow Palace arc, which devastated him.
claims.notes: 'Word Soul' devil title not confirmed in snippets. Motive varies: corrupting Licht's grimoire vs manifesting in the living world.

claims.statement: Nacht Faust teaches/performs the Devil-Binding Ritual (ch. 267-272, Volume 27: 'The Devil-Binding Ritual', 'Devil', 'Together', 'Union'). Asta defeats Liebe despite losing his right arm and asks him to be friends / equals instead of a servant. Devil Union originally lasts about five minutes; later extended to ten minutes with partial union (ch. 334). Learning Licita is a shared mother is later (ch. ~326-328).
claims.temporalAnchor: Ch. 267-272 (Vol. 27); ch. 318 (4 min left of 5); ch. 334 (10 min); ch. 326-328 (Licita)
claims.notes: Conflicting reports of 'five seconds' in ch. 327-328 - treat with caution. Which chapter Asta offers friendship is not pinned down.

claims.statement: Asta's heavy Anti-Magic swords are tied to his physical training; Yuno tried a sword and called Asta a 'muscle-bound freak' (ch. 381 per source). The 'only Asta can wield it' wording applies in sources mostly to the Demon-Dweller sword; mages lose magic on contact. Do not say Demon-Slayer is 'only wieldable by Asta' without checking.
claims.notes: Source wording is fan/news summary; exact manga quote not seen.

claims.statement: Damnatio Kira, chairman of the Magic Parliament (House Kira), puts Asta and Secre Swallowtail on trial (the Devil Trial) over the elf reincarnation and possession of Magic Knights; Asta must reveal his devil power (Black form) to save Marie Adlai; the Black Bulls intervene and eventually Asta and Secre are declared innocent.
claims.temporalAnchor: Anime ep. ~122 'As Pitch Black as It Gets'; Devil Trial arc
claims.notes: The trial is about blaming Asta for elves' reincarnation, not 'devil's power' per se; the devil power is revealed during the trial.

claims.statement: Chapter 333 confirmed that Julius Novachrono and Lucius Zogratis share one body as two souls. Lucius's foresight (Time Magic) cannot see futures where Asta is involved - ch. 348 notes Lucius could not foresee a future with Asta in Hino Country - and Anti-Magic is described as a counter to Time Magic (ch. 334). Calling Asta his only flaw/variable is a reader interpretation, not stated outright.
claims.notes: Astaroth as the Time devil not confirmed in snippets. 'Eldest Zogratis sibling' not confirmed.

claims.statement: Noelle used a wand to cope with her uncontrollable mana (a Sea Dragon's technique is named variously Cradle/Nest/Roar). Finral's Spatial Magic lacking an attack, Vanessa's Red Thread of Fate awakening in the Witch Forest, Henry's curse and base-moving, and Nacht as vice-captain spy in Spade were NOT confirmed by any result.
claims.notes: Where the wand came from was not found. Spell names conflict across sources. Needs a dedicated check.

claims.statement: Yuno Grinberryall's pendant is the last magic stone (blue, gold cross with four-pointed stars), given by his father; he is of Spade Kingdom royal lineage (parents Loyce, sun magic, and Ciel, moon magic). Zagred stole the stone and Gueldre and Revchi later recovered it.
claims.notes: 'Prince' title specifically not stated in snippet; the pendant's origin differs between sources (demon's lair vs Grand Magic Zone).

claims.statement: Asta's first devil-form transformation occurs in the Witch Forest arc around ch. 97-98 (anime ep. 63) against Ladros; the Witch Queen's blood magic removed his curse and is tied to the form activation. 'Black Asta' as a named full form is placed at ch. 273 by one source.
claims.notes: Sources contradict on 'forced out by the Witch Queen'; the Witch Queen did not clearly 'force' it. Verify.

claims.statement: Lucifero killed Licita (shown ch. ~326-328). Lucifero is defeated in chapter 329 by Asta and Liebe, with Yuno's star magic help (and Yami and Nacht per one source). Sources conflict on whether he is fully dead.
claims.notes: Chapter 329 title per Sportskeeda: 'The King of Devils and the Boys with No Magic'. The final antagonist is Lucius, defeated in the final arc (series ends ch. 392).

claims.statement: Wikipedia and a fan wiki both say Asta has trained his body intensely since childhood to compensate for having no magic; specific exercises (pushups, running) were NOT found.
claims.notes: Do not invent a training montage list; use Ch. 1 pages directly.
